title: Keeping the beings out of the official report to protect his Personnel Reliability Program status
summary: Mario Woods tells of Keeping the beings out of the official report to protect his Personnel Reliability Program status, about 1977 at Ellsworth AFB, South Dakota, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: had I said that I saw these beings they would have immediately removed me from the PE RP personal reliability program

plain: Mario Woods, who guarded nuclear weapons at Ellsworth, an Air Force base in South Dakota, tells podcast host Jesse Michels that in 1977 he left the beings he says he saw out of his official report. He explains that saying he saw them would have got him removed at once from the Personnel Reliability Program, the military's screening of people trusted near nuclear weapons. If true, it would mean such sightings go unreported because guards fear losing their posts.
